"""Fit only new hard-label vectors and use the existing complete two-task evaluator."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from _impl.data import dataset
from _impl.evaluate import run, verify
from _impl.io import digest, save_json
from _impl.models import initialize, load_checkpoint
from experiment.distill import save_student, train

output = Path('outputs/finite_hard_label_20261103')
registration = Path('results/data_free_compensation/hard_label')
protocol = json.loads((registration / 'protocol.json').read_text())
plan = json.loads((registration / 'students.json').read_text())
assert digest(__file__) == plan['driver_sha256'] and digest(registration/'protocol.json') == plan['query_protocol_sha256']
initialize()
torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
query_root = Path(protocol['output'])
seen = {r['target']: r for r in json.loads((query_root/'comparison.json').read_text())}
for case in protocol['cases']:
    task = case['target']
    rule = json.loads(Path(case['training_protocol']).read_text())
    partner = rule['partner']
    old = plan['references'][task]
    assert digest(old['path']) == old['sha256']
    query_file = query_root/(task + '_queries.pt')
    assert digest(query_file) == seen[task]['raw_sha256']
    current = torch.load(query_file, map_location='cpu', weights_only=False)
    assert digest(case['previous_queries']) == protocol['historical_inputs'][case['previous_queries']]
    previous = torch.load(case['previous_queries'], map_location='cpu', weights_only=False)
    assert previous['indices'] == current['indices']
    labels = current['scores']['Defense2'].argmax(1)
    historical = previous['labels']
    prior_defense = historical['Defense2'] if isinstance(historical, dict) else historical
    groups = {'KD_Unprotected': current['scores']['Unprotected'].argmax(1), 'KD_Defense2': prior_defense}
    match = next((name for name, vector in groups.items() if torch.equal(labels, vector)), None)
    folder = output/task
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    if match:
        save_json(folder/'reuse.json', dict(student=match, original_scores=old, query_sha256=digest(query_file), identical_labels=len(labels), new_backward_steps=0))
        print(task, 'reused', match, flush=True)
        continue
    expert = load_checkpoint(task+'/finetuned.pt')
    data = dataset(task, 'data', expert.val_preprocess, training=True)
    images = torch.stack([data[i][0] for i in current['indices']])
    assert hashlib.sha256(images.numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest() == case['image_tensor_sha256']
    del expert, data
    base, head = load_checkpoint('zeroshot.pt'), load_checkpoint('head_'+task+'.pt')
    trial, pilot = train(base, head, images, labels, rule, pilot=True)
    del trial
    student, training = train(base, head, images, labels, rule)
    release = save_student(student, base, folder/'student.pt')
    assert training['backward_steps'] == protocol['student_budget'][task]
    save_json(folder/'freeze.json',dict(release=release,pilot=pilot,training=training,image_sha256=case['image_tensor_sha256'],query_sha256=digest(query_file)))
    del student, base, head, images
    parent = json.loads(Path('results/data_free_compensation/finite_eight/evaluation.json').read_text())
    cfg = {k:parent[k] for k in ['tasks','TA_coefficient','pilot_n','replay_n','score_tolerance','AGA','AGA_references']}
    cfg.update(output=str(folder/'evaluation'), cases=[dict(target=task,partner=partner,defenses=['KD_Updated'])],
               defenses={'KD_Updated':dict(target=task,release=release)},mergers=['TA'],attack_scopes=['None'],
               source_sha256=protocol['source_sha256'],legacy={task+'_'+partner+'/Unprotected':old['legacy']})
    cfg['tasks'] = {name:cfg['tasks'][name] for name in [task,partner]}
    path = folder/'evaluation.json';save_json(path,cfg)
    for pilot_mode in [True,False]:
        run(path,0,pilot_mode)
        verify(folder/'evaluation'/('pilot' if pilot_mode else 'full')/f'00_{task}_{partner}')
    print(task, 'full evaluation verified', flush=True)
scope: Paired student recovery compared on standalone and TA0.5 without further recovery. Reuse the original final student only on identical complete label vectors. Other students follow the same recorded training budget.
